name: Salary Benchmark
purpose: Compares yearly pay for each job title across industries and countries

inputs.base_salary: Yearly salary, before bonuses and other extra pay
inputs.bonus_pay: Bonuses, overtime and other extra pay the person gets in a year, on top of salary
inputs.currency: Currency the salary is paid in
inputs.years_in_field: Years of experience the person has in their current field
inputs.employer_name: Name of the company the person works for
inputs.hours_per_week: Number of hours the person works in a typical week
